text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: P1321 - embedding-store KV eviction spike in us-west-2 -> page sent to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert details: 2000 evictions / 5m, error budget burn accelerating. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/p/1321
sam (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm on it, will gather quick impact and mitigation.
lee (sre): Saw traces; eviction correlates with batched-backfill job at 21:04 UTC.
sam (oncall): Quick customer impact: low-level 503 for long-tail requests hitting cold cache. No widespread API failure yet. Notifying support. @kai can you confirm if any customer tickets?
kai (support): Confirmed two inbound chats reporting slower responses for large batch jobs. Escalated to SE.
alisha (eng-sre): Repulling logs now. Adding runbook tag. Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/789012/KV+Eviction+Runbook
sam (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause backfill job 2) Increase cache TTL on embed-store nodes 3) Add temporary eviction throttle 4) If still high, failover region routing to eu-west-1.
nina (secondary): I'll take pause/backfill and TTL change. Sam, you want me to open a temporary config PR?
sam (oncall): Yes. Nina, create PR withTTL bump from 60s -> 300s and tag me @sam for quick review.
lee (sre): Patch applied to staging, rolling to prod now. Command run:
```
kubectl -n embed-store set env deploy/cache NODE_CACHE_TTL=300
kubectl -n embed-store rollout restart deploy/cache
```
lee (sre): rollout started. Watching pod restarts and eviction metric.
incident-bot: Deployment event: rollout/canary/embed-cache -> succeeded (3/3 pods ready)
sam (oncall): Eviction rate dropped 40% in the last 2 minutes. Good signal. Keeping monitoring.
maria (prod): Noted small uptick in tail latency for embeddings, but error rate trending down.
kai (support): Customer chats updated: one customer still seeing retries, but they've acknowledged mitigation and are ok with temporary throttling.
ops-rotation-bot: Reminder: @nina is secondary for the 22:00-06:00 UTC window. Ensure handoff notes posted 15m before shift change.
sam (oncall): Current status: mitigations applied (TTL bump, paused backfill), eviction rate falling, partial customer impact limited to long-tail batch jobs. No rollback needed.
nina (secondary): Action items I have: pause backfill (done), PR for TTL (pending sam review), add throttle rule to lb for batch requests, update runbook's telemetry links.
sam (oncall): Next steps for night team: 1) Confirm eviction stays < 10% of baseline for 30m 2) If evictions reappear, flip routing to eu-west-1 for heavy batch jobs (runbook has steps) 3) Keep support updated and close customer tickets when stable
lee (sre): Quick note: there's a small coverage gap for APAC morning (02:00 UTC) where scheduled maintenance overlaps our backup routing. Recommend we slot a brief standby with APAC SREs.
sam (oncall): Good catch. @alisha can you coordinate a 02:00 standby with APAC oncall? If not possible, we'll extend the throttle window.
alisha (eng-sre): I'll ping APAC oncall and confirm standby. If no response by 23:30 UTC, we'll extend throttle through 04:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident P1321 -> status: mitigated (watching). Timeline: triggered 21:03 UTC, mitigations applied 21:10 UTC, partial recovery 21:12 UTC.
sam (oncall): Handoff notes for next shift (copy into passback):
- What happened: KV eviction spike triggered by backfill job causing tail 503s for large batch embedding requests.
- What we did: paused offending job, bumped cache TTL from 60s -> 300s, applied throttle for batch route, monitored metrics and customer reports.
- Current status: eviction rate down ~75% from peak; latency improving; support has triaged affected customers.
- Open items: PR needs sam review and merge (nina), confirm APAC standby (alisha), consider runbook edit to add automated backfill guard (owner: eng-infra).
- Escalation: if evictions > baseline for 15m after 00:00 UTC, page oncall and consider region failover.
sam (oncall): I'll be primary through 23:45 UTC. @nina you take primary at 23:45 UTC?
nina (secondary): I can take the handoff at 23:45 UTC. I'll post a final pass when I pick up.
lee (sre): Leaving a quick grep of the suspicious job logs for next shift:
```
jobs/backfill/2026-05-14T21:03:12Z INFO processed=4500 batch_size=512 duration_ms=342000
jobs/backfill/2026-05-14T21:03:13Z WARN cache_evictions=198
```
maria (prod): Adding link to customer-facing incident note in #support-updates when we close.
sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll post a condensed pass to rotation channel at 23:40 UTC. If anything regresses tag @sam and escalate. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P1321 closed to Paging, moving to Watchlist.
